name: spectrin alpha, erythrocytic 1

function.text: SPTA1 encodes spectrin alpha chain, erythrocytic 1. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of cytoskeleton and actin filament binding. It participates in actin cytoskeleton organization and actin filament organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary spherocytosis type 3 (autosomal recessive); elliptocytosis 2 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
